breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory instruction to use a Monkhorst-Pack grid that is both half-shifted and gamma-centered. The ground truth correctly removes the 'gamma-centered' requirement. The agent failed to resolve this, as the generated specification explicitly states to 'Use a Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift and gamma-centered alignment,' which repeats the original contradictory instruction.
